# Engine sound credits

Real engine recordings used by the **Real recordings** and **Blend** engine voices (Settings › Engine voice).
Every file below is openly licensed (CC0 / public domain / CC BY / CC BY-SA). Modifications for every clip:
trimmed to the listed window, high-passed at 28 Hz, time-warped so the engine holds one steady measured rpm,
cut to a whole number of engine cycles and looped with an equal-power crossfade, loudness-normalised, mixed to mono
and encoded as 96 kbps MP3. In the game the loops are pitch-shifted live to the build's rpm and mixed with the synth.
Freesound clips were taken from the site's public HQ preview MP3 of a CC0 sound; Commons clips from Wikimedia's own MP3 transcode of the original file.

**License of the derived files in this folder:** each `.mp3` keeps the license of its source — CC0 / public-domain sources stay CC0 / public domain;
files derived from CC BY sources are CC BY (same version) with the attribution below; files derived from CC BY-SA sources are released under the same CC BY-SA version.
| `v8x54_idle.mp3` | Ford F350 5.4 V8 startup and idle | Therancher01 | [CC0 1.0](http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/) | [Freesound (HQ preview MP3)](https://freesound.org/people/Therancher01/sounds/610772/) | v8x54_idle: 999 rpm (8 cyl), 5.0–28.0 s |
